title: Monument A1: The welcome wall, redrafted
request:
Redraft the tale for Monument A1 (The welcome wall). Two earlier versions are source material: use any of their facts and jokes, copy neither whole.
- Prototype 7.13 (Farsight's voice; Farsight must not appear): A conveyor sets you down beside a tower. Its screen shows your face and the word WELCOME. Farsight is pleased to have you. Your first duty is simple: stand in the road until a colleague notices you.
- Prototype 8.1 (Dummy Corporation): A conveyor sets you down at the welcome wall, where a screen shows your face and the word WELCOME. Your first duty toward Certification: stand in the road until a colleague notices you.
Choose the length the tile needs, 15 to 35 words in at most two sentences: short when one image carries it, longer when the place has a history worth telling. Name the place, keep the duty and any equipment the tile issues, and point the place at the training.
